body.x: Parrot(www.parrot.com) showcases mini drone at 'CES Unveiled' of the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

MiniDrone by connected to a Smartphone or a tablet in Bluetooth Smart (Low Energy) offers flight stability worthy of professional drones. With its numerous sensors and its autopilot capabilities, MiniDrone is the easiest-to-fly quadricopter. Its ultra-compact and light-weight design combined with the power of its engines let MiniDrone perform high-speed flights and high-precision acrobatics. Thanks to the two ultra-light wheels, MiniDrone can climb along a wall and move across the ceiling before taking off again into mid-air.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
